name: Sofia Silva
headline: Full-Stack Developer
summary: Full-stack developer with experience building customer-facing products and internal tools across web applications and data-driven features. Comfortable working across the stack, improving delivery processes, and collaborating with product and design to ship reliable releases.

roles.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Built interactive user workflows with JavaScript and Redux, and kept versioned changes organized with Git across frequent releases.
Implemented SQL-backed features for reporting and account management, cutting manual lookup time by 35%.
Partnered with designers and support staff to refine the frontend experience and reduce user-reported issues by 22%.
Reviewed code changes with the team and stabilized shared components used across 3 product areas.

roles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Delivered new application screens in Angular and connected them to backend services, improving turnaround on feature requests by 28%.
Packaged services with Docker and tuned PostgreSQL queries to keep response times steady during peak usage.
Designed document workflows in MongoDB for a growing customer base, supporting 4 major product launches.
Worked closely with product managers and QA to remove release blockers and improve handoff quality.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Developed customer features in GraphQL and Redux, and maintained reliable data operations in PostgreSQL and SQL.
Expanded automated checks with Cypress and Jest, reducing regression defects by 40%.
Built and supported containerized services with Docker, helping the team ship 2 releases per month with fewer deployment issues.
Collaborated with engineers and analysts to improve data consistency and keep the product stable under heavier usage.
